# save customization when customer fied is empty and not required

From the FO, if I save the customization of a product while one of text field is empty and not required, an error appears.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/112863083/205098624-5cc617c4-5e0a-4983-bb3f-3fea08b5ad34.png)


![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/112863083/205098675-bf4746c5-d0ec-4713-b955-527952c13518.png)

## Attendu
the error should not appear

## Étapes
On BO :
1. Catalog > Products > Choose a product
2. Option > Add customization field, Type Text, and not Required
3. Save

On FO : 
4. Open the product on FO
5. do not fill in empty customization text fields
6. Save customization
7. See error
